contract.intended_consumer: A coding-agent coordinator deciding whether one blocked action prevents progress on an authorized outcome
contract.outcome: A blocked action cannot become a whole-goal stop while useful authorized work remains, and a genuine terminal wait is applied only through the existing safe scoped lifecycle.

canonical_journey.starting_state: One graph-backed goal has a blocked unit, an independent ready unit, and an unrelated live claim root.
canonical_journey.input: A deterministic blocker disposition bound to the exact graph and current claim snapshot.
canonical_journey.action: Apply the disposition through the sanctioned session lifecycle command.
canonical_journey.observable_result: Ready work continues; only a verified terminal wait can narrow, hand off, or retire the selected goal scope; unrelated roots and dirty work remain untouched.
canonical_journey.failure_signal: The goal stops while a unit is ready, an unverified blocker changes custody, or an unrelated claim/worktree is changed.

success_criteria.description: A whole-goal block is denied while any dependency-ready authorized unit remains.
Only a deterministic verified blocker disposition can change the selected goal scope through existing lifecycle writers.
Unrelated claim roots, worktrees, branches, trackers, and dirty work remain unchanged.
The source and installed command paths invoke the same canonical lifecycle behavior.

request.approval_text: Brian activated the outcome-ownership and action-scoped-blocker implementation goal on 2026-09-13.
